title: Australias Maas enters trading halt after Nvidia-backed Firmus shelves $5 billion IPO plan

Following this transaction, Portsmouth's estimated stake in the company would decrease significantly. Anthem Biosciences reported a decline in total income and profit after tax for the first quarter of FY27.

title: US bull market nears fourth anniversary, but narrow rally raises risks
excerpt: The ongoing US stock bull market is nearing its fourth anniversary with strong corporate earnings and low volatility. Investor concerns are rising due to the disparity between benchmark indices and the performance of individual stocks. The reliance on artificial intelligence for growth makes the market susceptible to volatility if sentiment shifts. Upcoming third-quarter earnings and midterm elections could introduce additional uncertainties for investors.
